company.description: Employer (Workday tenant) the job belongs to.

tenant.description: Workday tenant parsed from the URL, e.g. nvidia.

site.description: Workday site segment parsed from the URL, e.g. NVIDIAExternalCareerSite.

jobId.description: Requisition id from the board, e.g. JR2022712.

additionalLocations.description: Other locations the same requisition covers.

country.description: Country from the job detail, when Workday reports it.

postedOn.description: Raw posting age as the board words it, e.g. 'Posted 3 Days Ago'.

postedDaysAgo.description: The same age as a number of days; 0 means today.

startDate.description: Real publication date from the job detail.

timeType.description: Full time, part time and so on.

remote.description: true when the location says remote, work from home or anywhere.

jobDescription.description: Full description, only with includeDescription and inside its cap.

status.description: FOUND for a real job, NO_JOBS or an error code for a board that gave nothing.

reason.description: Why a board gave nothing - HTTP status or a hint about the URL.

fromCache.description: true when this row came from the cache instead of a live request.

fetchedAt.description: When the row was produced, ISO 8601.
